title: Style Meter
description: a style meter that goes up when you land combos, granting powerful buffs
body:
This datapack adds a unique style meter that constantly drains, you have to land attacks to gain more style which grants buffs.

Direct attacks (melee) : +100 style
Indirect attakcs (everything else, tnt or arrows for example) : +200 style
Kills : +400 style
Die : reset style

Ranks : (gaining a rank grants all perks of previous ranks, perks only stay for as long as you hold the rank)
300 - C ; no perks
900 - B ; Haste
2000 - A ; Speed
2600 - S ; Strength 
3500 - SS ; Resistance 
5000 - SSS ; Regeneration
10000 - secret rank ; no perks


Higher style = more style loss per second
